data.source: Binance public market data (data-api.binance.vision, keyless, USDT spot pairs)

approval_rule: A strategy is approved for paper trading only if it passes G1 (no look-ahead, costs on), G2 (Deflated Sharpe >= 0.95 with N = every crypto variant ever registered) and G3 (walk-forward OOS Sharpe >= 0.30 and >= 55% of OOS half-years profitable) AND its OOS Sharpe beats a buy-and-hold BTC position sized by the same 1%-risk / 20%-cap rules over the same OOS days. Among qualifiers the highest DSR wins. If none qualify: 100% cash (USD).

strategies.name: c_tsmom
strategies.title: Time-series trend per coin (long/cash)
strategies.mechanism: Crypto trends persist: slow information diffusion, reflexive flows and leverage cycles make past returns predict near-term returns (documented in Liu & Tsyvinski 2021). Hold a coin only while its own trailing return is positive.
critic: OOS Sharpe 1.06 beats risk-sized BTC (0.61), but CAGR 39.4% vs raw 100% BTC 20.4%: the edge is risk-adjusted, at ~46% average exposure.
Costs eat 4.28% a year (turnover 22.9x).
Without the one-bar shift the Sharpe would read 3.64 instead of 1.36.
OOS drawdown reached -47.9%; the 10% kill switch would have halted it on 2021-05-19 (backtest ignores the switch; live does not).
Survivorship: the 9 coins are today's surviving majors, picked in 2026 with hindsight (LUNA, FTT, EOS etc. are absent), which flatters every long-only crypto backtest.

strategies.name: c_xsmom
strategies.title: Cross-sectional momentum rotation (top-k, absolute filter)
strategies.mechanism: Capital rotates into the strongest coins (narratives, flows); hold the top-k by trailing return but only if that return is positive.

strategies.name: c_meanrev
strategies.title: Short-term dip buying inside an uptrend
strategies.mechanism: Forced liquidations overshoot; in an established uptrend (above 200d SMA) sharp multi-day drops tend to partially revert. Exit on recovery or trend loss.
critic: OOS Sharpe 0.46 does not beat risk-sized buy-and-hold BTC over the same days (0.61); raw 100% BTC: Sharpe 0.61, CAGR 20.4%, max DD -76.6%.
Best full-sample Sharpe 0.76 is not distinguishable from the best of 31 random crypto trials (hurdle 0.75): DSR 0.51.
Costs eat 0.53% a year (turnover 3.0x).
OOS Sharpe is only 48% of the in-sample Sharpe used to pick parameters.
OOS drawdown reached -10.5%; the 10% kill switch would have halted it on 2021-05-23 (backtest ignores the switch; live does not).
Survivorship: the 9 coins are today's surviving majors, picked in 2026 with hindsight (LUNA, FTT, EOS etc. are absent), which flatters every long-only crypto backtest.
